method.retrieval: retrieve-memory, scope notebook, k=8, local gte-small embeddings; every probe notebook also holds the same 50 synthetic unrelated background entities (eval/memory/fixtures/background.json), so ranking is among distractors
method.insertions: unrelated insertion = a retrieved background entity; other scenario entities are counted as sameStory; probe `related` names are left out of precision
method.staleNegation: a stale term counts only where asserted: not after not/never/instead of/rather than/no longer, nor in a sentence saying misspoke/corrected/correction
method.pathAttribution: combined: retrieve-memory returns one ranked list and does not say which path found an item
method.statusRule: decided is correct when a retrieved entity description or active relation contains a decided marker and none contains a tentative marker; Lumen stores no tentative/decided field, so this scores the stored text
method.limitation: N=1 extraction per scenario: no run-to-run spread is claimed
